entities.summary: Terry Gou (b. 1950-10-08, Banqiao District) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Banqiao District and Taiwan. Known in the fields of taiwan, merchants & economists, asia.
